id-20261022-news-1.title: Ahead of COP31 November 2026: What Is at Stake for Indonesia in Carbon Markets, Climate Finance, and Emission Targets

segments.src: Konferensi Perubahan Iklim PBB ke-31 (COP31) dijadwalkan berlangsung pada November 2026 di Antalya, Turki, dengan Australia memimpin proses negosiasi.
segments.tr: The 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) is scheduled for November 2026 in Antalya, Turkey, with Australia leading the negotiation process.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, pertemuan ini bukan sekadar agenda diplomasi.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, this meeting is not merely a diplomatic agenda.

segments.src: Hasilnya bisa memengaruhi arah bursa karbon, aliran dana transisi energi, dan beban penyesuaian bagi industri maupun rumah tangga.
segments.tr: Its outcomes could affect the direction of the carbon exchange, the flow of energy transition funding, and the adjustment burden on industry and households.

segments.src: Artikel ini merangkum tiga isu utama yang kemungkinan menjadi perhatian Indonesia, beserta dampak yang perlu dicermati.
segments.tr: This article summarizes three main issues that are likely to matter to Indonesia, along with the impacts that need watching.

segments.src: Angka dan jadwal dapat berubah, jadi pembaca disarankan merujuk pada dokumen resmi pemerintah dan sekretariat UNFCCC.
segments.tr: Figures and schedules may change, so readers are advised to refer to official government documents and the UNFCCC secretariat.

segments.src: ## Mengapa COP31 penting bagi Indonesia
segments.tr: ## Why COP31 matters for Indonesia

segments.src: Indonesia adalah salah satu negara dengan emisi gas rumah kaca terbesar di dunia.
segments.tr: Indonesia is one of the countries with the largest greenhouse gas emissions in the world.

segments.src: Emisi itu berasal dari sektor energi, kehutanan dan alih guna lahan, serta industri.
segments.tr: These emissions come from the energy sector, forestry and land-use change, and industry.

segments.src: Pada saat yang sama, Indonesia memiliki hutan tropis dan lahan gambut luas yang berperan besar sebagai penyerap karbon, serta cadangan nikel yang penting bagi rantai pasok baterai kendaraan listrik.
segments.tr: At the same time, Indonesia has extensive tropical forests and peatlands that play a major role as carbon sinks, as well as nickel reserves that are important to the electric vehicle battery supply chain.

segments.src: Posisi ganda ini membuat Indonesia berkepentingan pada aturan global yang adil.
segments.tr: This dual position means Indonesia has a stake in fair global rules.

segments.src: Negara ini ingin menekan emisi, tetapi juga perlu menjaga pertumbuhan ekonomi dan lapangan kerja.
segments.tr: The country wants to cut emissions, but it also needs to sustain economic growth and employment.

segments.src: ## 1. Pasar karbon dan bursa karbon
segments.tr: ## 1. Carbon markets and the carbon exchange

segments.src: Indonesia meluncurkan Bursa Karbon Indonesia (IDXCarbon) pada September 2023 di bawah pengawasan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK).
segments.tr: Indonesia launched the Indonesia Carbon Exchange (IDXCarbon) in September 2023 under the supervision of the Financial Services Authority (OJK).

segments.src: Perdagangan awalnya difokuskan pada unit karbon dari pembangkit listrik batu bara, lalu diperluas ke perdagangan karbon luar negeri dan sektor lain.
segments.tr: Trading initially focused on carbon units from coal-fired power plants, then expanded to international carbon trading and other sectors.

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang layak diperhatikan menjelang COP31:
segments.tr: Several matters deserve attention ahead of COP31:

segments.src: - **Aturan Pasal 6 Perjanjian Paris.** Pasal ini mengatur perdagangan karbon antarnegara. Kejelasan standar akan menentukan apakah kredit karbon Indonesia diakui pembeli luar negeri.
segments.tr: - **Article 6 of the Paris Agreement.** This article governs carbon trading between countries. Clear standards will determine whether Indonesian carbon credits are recognized by foreign buyers.

segments.src: - **Integritas kredit karbon.** Pembeli global semakin menuntut bukti bahwa pengurangan emisi benar-benar terjadi, tidak dihitung ganda, dan bersifat permanen.
segments.tr: - **Carbon credit integrity.** Global buyers increasingly demand proof that emission reductions truly occur, are not double-counted, and are permanent.

segments.src: - **Likuiditas bursa.** Volume transaksi di bursa karbon domestik masih relatif kecil dibanding potensinya. Kepastian regulasi dan harga menjadi kunci untuk menarik lebih banyak peserta.
segments.tr: - **Exchange liquidity.** Transaction volume on the domestic carbon exchange is still relatively small compared with its potential. Regulatory and price certainty are key to attracting more participants.

segments.src: - **Mekanisme penyesuaian karbon perbatasan.** Kebijakan seperti CBAM Uni Eropa dapat memengaruhi ekspor produk padat karbon, misalnya baja dan aluminium. Eksportir Indonesia perlu menyiapkan data emisi yang andal.
segments.tr: - **Carbon border adjustment mechanisms.** Policies such as the EU's CBAM could affect exports of carbon-intensive products, such as steel and aluminum. Indonesian exporters need to prepare reliable emissions data.

segments.src: ## 2. Pendanaan transisi energi
segments.tr: ## 2. Energy transition financing

segments.src: Transisi dari energi fosil ke energi bersih membutuhkan investasi besar.
segments.tr: The shift from fossil fuels to clean energy requires large investment.

segments.src: Salah satu kerangka yang paling sering dibahas adalah Kemitraan Transisi Energi yang Adil (JETP), yang diumumkan pada 2022 dengan komitmen awal sekitar 20 miliar dolar AS dari negara-negara mitra dan lembaga keuangan.
segments.tr: One of the frameworks most often discussed is the Just Energy Transition Partnership (JETP), announced in 2022 with an initial commitment of around US$20 billion from partner countries and financial institutions.

segments.src: Perkembangan kemitraan ini, termasuk perubahan sikap sejumlah mitra, menjadi catatan penting dalam diskusi pendanaan.
segments.tr: The partnership's development, including shifts in the stance of some partners, is an important point in the financing discussion.

segments.src: Isu yang kemungkinan mengemuka:
segments.tr: Issues likely to come up:

segments.src: - **Komposisi dana.** Proporsi hibah, pinjaman lunak, dan pinjaman komersial sangat memengaruhi beban utang negara.
segments.tr: - **Composition of funds.** The proportions of grants, concessional loans, and commercial loans strongly affect the state's debt burden.

segments.src: - **Percepatan penghentian pembangkit batu bara.** Pemerintah telah menyampaikan rencana mengurangi peran batu bara, tetapi laju dan sumber pembiayaannya masih perlu kejelasan.
segments.tr: - **Accelerating the phase-out of coal plants.** The government has conveyed plans to reduce coal's role, but the pace and source of financing still need clarity.

segments.src: - **Energi terbarukan.** Tenaga surya, panas bumi, dan tenaga air memiliki potensi besar. Hambatannya mencakup jaringan transmisi, perizinan, dan kepastian tarif.
segments.tr: - **Renewable energy.** Solar, geothermal, and hydropower have large potential. Obstacles include transmission networks, licensing, and tariff certainty.

segments.src: - **Target pendanaan iklim global.** Negara berkembang mendorong kenaikan dana iklim dari negara maju. Hasil perundingan akan menentukan seberapa besar ruang pembiayaan yang tersedia bagi Indonesia.
segments.tr: - **Global climate finance target.** Developing countries are pushing for higher climate finance from developed countries. The outcome of the negotiations will determine how much financing room is available to Indonesia.

segments.src: ## 3. Target pengurangan emisi
segments.tr: ## 3. Emission reduction targets

segments.src: Dalam Dokumen Kontribusi yang Ditetapkan secara Nasional (NDC), Indonesia menargetkan penurunan emisi sebesar 31,89 persen dengan upaya sendiri dan hingga 43,20 persen dengan dukungan internasional pada 2030, dibandingkan skenario tanpa tindakan.
segments.tr: In its Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC), Indonesia targets a 31.89 percent emission reduction with its own efforts and up to 43.20 percent with international support by 2030, compared with a business-as-usual scenario.

segments.src: Pemerintah juga menyebut target emisi nol bersih pada 2060 atau lebih cepat.
segments.tr: The government also cites a net-zero emissions target by 2060 or earlier.

segments.src: Pembaruan NDC dengan target tahun 2035 menjadi bahan evaluasi di COP31.
segments.tr: The NDC update with a 2035 target is a subject of evaluation at COP31.

segments.src: Pertanyaan yang sering diajukan pengamat antara lain:
segments.tr: Questions frequently raised by observers include:

segments.src: - Apakah target tersebut selaras dengan batas kenaikan suhu 1,5 derajat Celsius?
segments.tr: - Is the target aligned with the 1.5 degrees Celsius temperature limit?

segments.src: - Seberapa jelas rencana pelaksanaan di sektor energi, kehutanan, dan industri?
segments.tr: - How clear is the implementation plan in the energy, forestry, and industry sectors?

segments.src: - Bagaimana sistem pemantauan dan pelaporan emisi dijalankan secara transparan?
segments.tr: - How is the emissions monitoring and reporting system run transparently?

segments.src: ## Dampak bagi industri dan warga
segments.tr: ## Impact on industry and citizens

segments.src: **Bagi industri:**
segments.tr: **For industry:**

segments.src: - Perusahaan besar kemungkinan menghadapi kewajiban pelaporan emisi yang lebih ketat.
segments.tr: - Large companies will likely face stricter emissions reporting obligations.

segments.src: - Biaya karbon dapat memengaruhi sektor pembangkit listrik, semen, baja, dan pertambangan.
segments.tr: - Carbon costs may affect the power generation, cement, steel, and mining sectors.

segments.src: - Peluang baru muncul di energi terbarukan, efisiensi energi, dan proyek penyerapan karbon.
segments.tr: - New opportunities are emerging in renewable energy, energy efficiency, and carbon sink projects.

segments.src: **Bagi warga:**
segments.tr: **For citizens:**

segments.src: - Tarif listrik dapat terpengaruh oleh perubahan bauran energi dan kebijakan subsidi.
segments.tr: - Electricity tariffs may be affected by changes in the energy mix and subsidy policies.

segments.src: - Pekerja di sektor batu bara membutuhkan program pelatihan ulang dan perlindungan sosial agar transisi berjalan adil.
segments.tr: - Coal sector workers need retraining programs and social protection so the transition is fair.

segments.src: - Kendaraan listrik, transportasi publik, dan panel surya atap makin banyak menjadi pilihan, meski akses dan harganya belum merata.
segments.tr: - Electric vehicles, public transport, and rooftop solar panels are increasingly popular choices, although access and prices are not yet evenly distributed.

segments.src: - Komunitas adat dan masyarakat sekitar hutan perlu dilibatkan dalam proyek karbon agar manfaatnya sampai ke tingkat tapak.
segments.tr: - Indigenous communities and people living around forests need to be involved in carbon projects so the benefits reach the local level.

segments.src: ## Hal yang perlu dicermati
segments.tr: ## Points to watch

segments.src: 1. Hasil perundingan Pasal 6 dan standar pasar karbon.
segments.tr: 1. Outcomes of the Article 6 negotiations and carbon market standards.

segments.src: 2. Komitmen pendanaan baru dari negara maju dan bank pembangunan.
segments.tr: 2. New financing commitments from developed countries and development banks.

segments.src: 3. Penjelasan resmi pemerintah soal NDC terbaru dan peta jalan transisi energi.
segments.tr: 3. Official government explanations of the latest NDC and the energy transition roadmap.

segments.src: 4. Kebijakan turunan di dalam negeri, mulai dari regulasi OJK hingga tarif listrik.
segments.tr: 4. Domestic follow-up policies, from OJK regulations to electricity tariffs.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: COP31 akan menguji sejauh mana janji global diterjemahkan menjadi tindakan nyata.
segments.tr: COP31 will test how far global promises are turned into concrete action.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, tantangannya adalah menyeimbangkan ambisi iklim, kebutuhan pendanaan, dan kepentingan ekonomi nasional.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, the challenge is to balance climate ambition, financing needs, and national economic interests.

segments.src: Warga dapat mengikuti perkembangannya melalui sumber resmi dan pemberitaan yang kredibel.
segments.tr: Citizens can follow developments through official sources and credible news reporting.
